_note: Chapter 1: the storm comes back to Route 1 (after Nolan unsplices the storm-rod from the Cloud Clamp; the thunder, lightning and rain are played on the map first, OverworldScene.stormReturns). The four huddle in the first rain in years; Connor pings the group chat about his clamp (bible §10: group chat before his moments). Sets storm_returned's follow-on flag.

steps.title: THE STORM IS BACK
steps.text: The first rain on Route 1 in years. The lantern on the storm-rod is lit, and the eye inside is wide open.
Weather: restored. I did not have weather on the list.
I'm adding it to the list.
Chat, we're LIVE. Actual rain. In a video game. This is crazy.
Who are you talking to.
The chat.
There is no chat.
Mamá is calling. ...Hola, Mamá. Is raining.
No. No, I don't have the jacket. ¡NO TENGO CHAQUETA, MAMÁ! ¡ES UN VIDEOJUEGO!
Connor joined the chat
yo who touched the cloud clamp
that was approved
it has to stay dry for the festival. festival vibes
You CANCELLED the festival.
rescheduled
anyway i'll come look at it. might be a bit late
Connor left the chat
He runs the Tally. Connor is the guy who rain-checked the rain.
Honestly the most Connor thing I've ever heard.
Something under the rod is humming. I'd pick that up. Carefully. With gloves. You don't have gloves.
